meta.name: genomic-coordinates
meta.description: Convert genomic intervals between coordinate conventions, normalise and compare variant representations, and detect assembly or contig-naming mismatches before they corrupt an analysis. Use whenever coordinates cross a format, tool, or assembly boundary - converting between BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, SAM/BAM, WIG, PSL, genePred, Picard interval_list, or region strings; reconciling 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive; left-aligning or trimming indels; checking whether two variant records describe the same change; mapping genomic to transcript, CDS, or protein positions; auditing a BED/GTF/VCF for convention violations; or diagnosing GRCh37 vs hg19 vs GRCh38 vs T2T, chr-prefix, and liftover problems. Triggers include "off by one", "0-based", "1-based", "half-open", "coordinate system", "left-align", "normalize variant", "bcftools norm", "chr prefix", "wrong genome build", "liftover", "REF mismatch", and "HGVS".

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把基因组坐标在不同格式(如 BED、GFF、VCF)间转换,核对 0-based 与 1-based 规则;对变异做修剪和左对齐,比较两个变异是否相同;还能检查文件是否用错基因组版本或染色体命名,并审计文件是否符合自身格式规则。
howto.when: 当你提到 “off by one”“0-based”“liftover” 等关键词,或要求转换坐标格式、标准化变异、检查基因组组装版本时,它会接管处理。

howto.what_en: Claude converts genomic intervals between coordinate conventions (BED, GFF/GTF, VCF, etc.), reconciles 0-based half-open with 1-based inclusive, left-aligns/trims indels, checks whether two variants are equivalent, and audits files for assembly or contig-naming mismatches and format violations.
howto.when_en: When you mention keywords like "off by one", "0-based", "liftover", or ask to convert coordinate formats, normalize variants, or check genome build consistency.

say_en.note: Outputs 0-based half-open interval and states the conversion direction.

say_en.text: Normalize chr1:7:CAC:C and compare with chr1:2:GCA:G.
say_en.note: Requires a reference FASTA; REF is checked first.

say_en.text: Check whether variants.vcf and annotation.gtf use the same genome build.
say_en.note: Reads headers and reports all incompatibilities.
